verdict.rationale: Greptile's documentation describes self-hosting the core code review product in your own infrastructure. Docker Compose covers up to 100 developers and Kubernetes covers 100+ with horizontal scaling and high availability, across AWS, GCP, Azure, and air-gapped environments. It also supports custom or self-hosted LLMs, logs stored only on customer servers, and API-key CLI use for self-hosted deployments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that self-hosted deployment works as documented.
